topic: Index Browser Agent Review 2026: Open-Source Alternative to Operator and Computer Use

competitors.name: Browser Use
key_points: 105K+ GitHub stars — most popular open-source browser agent
MIT license, Python/Playwright-based
Lets AI agents use browsers like humans: click, type, fill forms
Supports form filling, data extraction, QA automation
Cloud offering available at cloud.browser-use.com
Active community with Discord and blog
Can be installed via 'browser-use skill install' for agent integration

competitors.name: Skyvern
key_points: 22.4K GitHub stars, AGPL-3.0 license
Uses LLMs + computer vision for browser automation
85.8% score on WebVoyager benchmark (v2.0)
Swarm of agents architecture: comprehend, plan, execute
Resistant to website layout changes — no XPath dependencies
Cloud version with anti-bot detection, proxy network, CAPTCHA solvers
No-code workflow builder available

competitors.name: Nanobrowser
key_points: 13.5K GitHub stars, Apache-2.0 license
Chrome extension — runs entirely in local browser
Free alternative to OpenAI Operator ($200/month)
Multi-agent system: Planner + Navigator agents collaborate
Privacy-focused: everything runs locally, no cloud sharing
Supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama, Groq, Cerebras, Llama
Interactive side panel with real-time status updates

competitors.name: Phantomix
key_points: Very early-stage project (2 stars)
Positioned as free alternative to OpenAI Operator
Minimal community adoption — not a serious competitor yet

stats.fact: Index has 2,339 GitHub stars and 125 forks as of July 2026
Index is built by Laminar AI, a Y Combinator S24 company
Index supports Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, OpenAI o4-mini, and Gemini 2.5 Flash
Browser Use is the dominant open-source browser agent with 105K+ GitHub stars
Skyvern v2.0 scored 85.8% on the WebVoyager benchmark
OpenAI Operator costs $200/month as a closed-source alternative
Index provides structured output via Pydantic schemas for reliable data extraction
Index offers serverless API, interactive CLI, and Chat UI interfaces
Index integrates with Laminar for browser agent observability and tracing
